Source: [pkg/detector/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/pkg/detector/doc.go).

Package detector turns graph changes into investigation signals.

It sits between the change feed and pkg/reasoning, which hands it the previous and current canonical snapshots for a change window. It returns [InvestigationSignal](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#InvestigationSignal) values. pkg/reasoning turns an active rule's signal into a finding directly, queues built-in novelty signals for agentic investigation, and only records shadow rule signals (marked [RuleModeShadow](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#RuleModeShadow)).

The detector reads only provider-neutral graph data: resolved relationships, typed [graph.SecuritySemantics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#SecuritySemantics), network roles, and bounded telemetry fingerprints. It never parses provider-native payloads or opens provider watches.

## Signal sources {#hdr-Signal_sources}

[Engine.Detect](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Engine.Detect) combines three sources and deduplicates them by signal ID:

  - Built-in novelty ([DetectNovelChanges](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#DetectNovelChanges)): new workload-level communication paths, scored telemetry novelty, new external exposure, changed or removed security semantics, lost governance, sensitive resource creation, and workload identity changes. Instances are folded into the controller that instantiates them, so rollouts and scaling are not novel, and ordinary graph churn emits nothing. See [Config](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Config) for the scoring.
  - CEL rules from the active [Ruleset](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Ruleset). [Events](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Events) derives one [Event](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Event) per new or newly resolved relationship edge and per newly observed telemetry combination; [Engine.Evaluate](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Engine.Evaluate) matches each against rules selected by plugin, input type, kind, and optional workload. Each (type, kind) selector compiles in its own CEL environment that declares only the [Input](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Input) fields that selector populates, so a rule that reads an unset field fails to compile instead of silently never matching.
  - Workload rules ([WorkloadRule](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#WorkloadRule)), such as model-authored Deployment rules, indexed by workload so each input is matched only against the rules of the workload that is its subject ([Event.SubjectIDs](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Event.SubjectIDs)); a workload's rules never match inputs where it is only the object. Each runs in [RuleModeActive](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#RuleModeActive) or [RuleModeShadow](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#RuleModeShadow).

## Rulesets and reload {#hdr-Rulesets_and_reload}

A compiled ruleset is immutable. [Engine.Reload](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Engine.Reload) compiles a newly activated ruleset completely before swapping it in atomically, so every evaluation runs against exactly one pinned ruleset and records its ID, digest, and activation revision. A reload failure keeps the last known-good ruleset and is reported through [Engine.Status](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Engine.Status). Invalid workload rules are skipped and counted rather than unloading the whole overlay. Evaluation errors are returned, never treated as "no match", so reasoning records the window as failed instead of claiming it was evaluated.

## Bounds {#hdr-Bounds}

Rulesets hold at most 256 rules and the workload overlay at most [MaxWorkloadRules](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#MaxWorkloadRules). Expressions are at most 8 KiB and 10,000 CEL cost units, with no host I/O functions. An evaluation reads at most [MaxEvaluationEvents](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#MaxEvaluationEvents) inputs of 64 KiB each and emits at most [MaxEvaluationSignals](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#MaxEvaluationSignals) rule signals; the rest are counted in [Result.Omitted](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Result.Omitted) rather than failing the evaluation. Raw IP addresses are never exposed to CEL; only their [telemetry](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/telemetry) destination class is.

See docs/architecture/detection-rules.md for rule authoring and storage.
